jobs.description:
Carhartt WIP is part of the WIP Trading AG. Our family-owned business group started as a licensee and European distributor of the US workwear manufacturer Carhartt in the early 1990s. Since then, it develops its own collections based on workwear originals.

Carhartt Work In Progress aims to continuously progress and evolve, without ever losing sight of its origins. Over the course of the past three decades, our business has developed organically, along with its customers, the culture that surrounds the brand, and its employees who have helped shape what Carhartt WIP is today.

For our outlet in Roermond we are looking for you as Sales Assistant (m/f/x) part time 16 hrs.

Tasks

- Provide excellent customer service and adapt brand stories to the retail setting

- Ensure optimum sales levels are met

- Ensure that all operational store policies and procedures are followed

- Take pride in store appearance and embrace the Carhartt store look

- To develop your product knowledge and understanding of the business

- Establish consumer loyalty and satisfaction

- Have fun selling our product whilst engaging with our valued customers

Requirements

- Customer service and/or retail experience preferred

- Dedicated, team-oriented and flexible

- Excellent communication and 'people' skills

- Confidence, drive and enthusiasm

- Fluency in English, Dutch and German are advantageous

Your Location

Roermond / Netherlands
